title: 第17章 他以为她是只属于他一个人的小猫
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
总裁办公室位于大厦顶层，一整面落地玻璃幕墙，能将半个帝都的繁华尽收眼底。

    夕阳的余晖斜照进来，给冷色调的装潢镀上了一层暖金色，却丝毫驱不散室内几乎凝成实质的低气压。

    江彻闭着眼坐在办公桌后的真皮高背椅上，整个人陷在宽大的椅背里。

    他没开主灯，只有一盏台灯在桌角亮着，昏黄的光圈将他笼在中央。

    他穿着剪裁合体的黑色衬衫，领口松开了两颗扣子，双腿随意地交叠着，修长的手指有一搭没一搭地敲击着座椅扶手，发出沉闷的声响。

    桌面的黑色大理石泛着光泽，一沓照片散落在上，有些叠在一起，有些单独铺开，像是被反复看过很多遍。

    最上面那张，是在女生宿舍楼下。

    叶闻白站在花坛边，微微低头，看着面前的人。安怜站在他对面，仰着脸，两个人之间的距离很近，近到是个人都能看两人出关系不一般。

    旁边那张是叶闻白牵着安怜的手，十指相扣，姿态亲昵。安怜侧着脸，似乎在说什么，嘴角上扬，阳光落在她脸上，把她的侧脸线条照得很柔和。

    再旁边，是叶闻白搂着安怜腰。

    角度拍得极好，叶闻白高大的身躯将安怜整个人笼罩在阴影里，他低头凑近她耳畔，嘴唇几乎贴上了她的耳廓。

    安怜耳朵红得能滴血，眼神躲闪着，说不出的娇羞与乖巧。

    还有一张是咖啡厅里的。

    叶婉清坐在安怜对面，面前摆着咖啡杯。

    安怜端端正正地坐着，像个被老师叫去谈话的学生。

    这张照片拍得不够清晰，度有些偏，但安怜脸上的表情还是能看得一清二楚。

    紧张、局促，还有一点点不知所措。

    后山观景台那张拍得最好看。

    暮色渐浓，天边还剩最后一抹橘红色的晚霞。

    叶闻白和安怜并肩站在矮墙边，安怜靠在他怀里，肩上披着他的外套。叶闻白揽着她的肩，低头看着她的发顶，嘴角带着一抹淡淡的笑。

    整张照片的氛围温柔得像一幅画，谁来了不得夸一句郎才女貌甚是般配。

    林助理站在办公桌前方三步远的地方，后背的衬衫被冷汗浸湿了一片。

    他不敢说话，也不敢大声呼吸，只能眼观鼻鼻观心。

    他跟了江彻五年，见过他在谈判桌上翻手为云覆手为雨，见过他在商业竞争中杀伐果断不留活路，也见过他心情好时随手签下千万金币的慈善支票。

    但像今天这样的，他没见过。
content_en:
The president's office is located on the top floor of the building, with an entire floor-to-ceiling glass curtain wall that offers a panoramic view of half of the prosperity of the imperial capital.

    The afterglow of the setting sun slanted in, coating the cold-toned decoration with a layer of warm gold, but it did not dispel the low air pressure that had almost condensed into a substance in the room.

    Jiang Che sat on the leather high-backed chair behind his desk with his eyes closed, his whole body sunk into the wide back of the chair.

    He didn't turn on the main light, only a desk lamp was lit at the corner of the table, and the dim halo of light enveloped him in the center.

    He was wearing a well-tailored black shirt, with two buttons unbuttoned at the collar. His legs were crossed casually, and his slender fingers tapped the armrest of the seat, making a dull sound.

    The black marble on the tabletop is shiny, and a stack of photos are scattered on it, some stacked together and some spread out individually, as if they have been viewed many times.

    The top one is downstairs in the girls' dormitory.

    Ye Wenbai stood by the flower bed, lowered his head slightly and looked at the person in front of him. An Lian stood opposite him, with her face raised. The distance between the two people was very close, so close that even a person could tell that the relationship between the two was unusual.

    The picture next to it shows Ye Wenbai holding An Lian's hand, with their fingers intertwined in an intimate gesture. An Lian turned her face sideways, as if she was saying something, and raised the corners of her mouth. The sunlight fell on her face, illuminating the lines of her profile very softly.

    Next to him, there was Ye Wenbai holding An Lian's waist.

    The angle was excellent. Ye Wenbai's tall body shrouded An Lian in shadow. He lowered his head and leaned close to her ear, his lips almost touching her auricle.

    An Lian's ears were so red that they could bleed, her eyes were evasive, and she was indescribably shy and well-behaved.

    Another one is from a coffee shop.

    Ye Wanqing sat opposite An Lian, with a coffee cup in front of her.

    An Lian sat upright, like a student who was called to talk by the teacher.

    The photo wasn't clear enough and was a little off, but the expression on An Lian's face could still be seen clearly.

    Nervous, cramped, and a little overwhelmed.

    The picture from the back mountain observation deck is the best.

    The dusk is getting darker, and there is still the last touch of orange-red sunset on the horizon.

    Ye Wenbai and An Lian stood side by side by the low wall. An Lian leaned in his arms with his coat draped over his shoulders. Ye Wenbai held her shoulders and looked down at the top of her hair with a faint smile on his lips.

    The atmosphere of the whole photo is as gentle as a painting. No one can say that the talent and appearance of the man are a perfect match.

    Assistant Lin stood three steps away from the desk, the shirt on his back soaked with cold sweat.

    He didn't dare to speak or breathe loudly. He could only watch his eyes, nose and heart.

    He has followed Jiang Che for five years, and has seen him turn his hands into clouds and rain at the negotiation table. He has seen him kill decisively in business competitions without leaving any chance of survival. He has also seen him casually sign charity checks worth tens of millions of gold coins when he is in a good mood.

    But he has never seen anything like today.
title_en: Chapter 17 He thought she was a kitten that only belonged to him
